editorial:
Imagine spending your nights in a cold, creepy hospital basement surrounded by dead bodies. That is exactly where you find yourself with the main character, a medical student who is just trying to finish her degree. She starts noticing that something is very wrong with one specific body in the morgue. People who touch the body or treat it badly start dying in scary ways. It feels like a classic ghost story but set in a place that already makes your skin crawl. The movie does a great job of making you feel uneasy every time a character walks down a dark hallway or opens a metal drawer.

You will find that the movie moves along quickly and keeps you guessing about who will be next. The acting is solid, though some of the scares are a bit predictable. If you love movies where a curse spreads through a group of people, you will really enjoy this one.
endingExplained: You will find out that the spirit in the body is actually a vengeful ghost looking for payback. The main character tries to stop the killing, but the spirit is too strong. In the final scenes, the ghost targets the people who were most cruel to the body. After a scary showdown in the hospital, the curse finally ends, but not before most of the staff are gone. It wraps up with a chilling reminder that some secrets should stay buried.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves medical horror and ghost stories.
